sculksight.config.title: Sculk Sight
sculksight.config.shell_opacity.tooltip: How solid the detection shell looks. The see-through pass follows this at a fixed proportion, so one slider moves both.
sculksight.config.render_policy.tooltip: Draw selected sensors as one merged shape (Union), or one coloured shell per sensor (Per-sensor).
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.name: %s (%s, %s, %s)
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.enable: Toggle whether this sensor's shell is rendered.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.remove: Remove this sensor from the tracked-render list immediately.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.rename: Open a text field to rename this sensor.
